description: Configure the Telegram channel for this agent — register a bot token from @BotFather and link the chat(s) allowed to message the agent. The token is verified with Telegram and stored encrypted. Defaults to poll mode (call telegram_poll on a schedule); pass mode "webhook" with a public HTTPS webhookUrl + webhookSecret for push delivery.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

allowedChatIds.description: Additional chat ids permitted to message the agent. An empty allow-list means only the operator chat can reach the agent (fail-closed).

mode.description: Inbound transport: "poll" (default — pull updates with telegram_poll) or "webhook" (Telegram pushes updates).

operatorChatId.description: The chat id of the operator — always allowed to message the agent and to answer ask_operator questions.

webhookSecret.description: Webhook mode only: shared secret echoed in the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header (at least 16 chars, A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -).

webhookUrl.description: Webhook mode only: public HTTPS URL Telegram delivers updates to.

name: telegram_setup
